rationale: P0 must reject deliberately invalid scientific input without converting the rejection into a physical material claim
the control tests input validation, not natural-material performance
a scientifically unsupported representation must block execution rather than be silently approximated
representation failure is not evidence that the material fails in nature
out-of-domain model behavior must remain UNKNOWN or INDETERMINATE unless independent evidence resolves it
foundation-model support is a property of the model/domain relation, not of the material itself
